assumptions.statement: Official redlines, parcels, ownership, existing-building survey, heritage-control zones, road redlines, utilities, and approved intensity controls are not present in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All parcel, scale, retain-renovate-demolish, and engineering decisions remain directional until official inputs and professional review are available.

assumptions.statement: The repository provisional overall boundary and three rough key-area polygons are used as temporary calculation and drawing envelopes only.
assumptions.impact: Replace the polygons and rerun every geometry-derived metric, figure, visual page, and PDF before statutory or implementation use.

assumptions.statement: No field survey, resident interview, accessibility walk-through, business interview, or stakeholder workshop was performed for this submission.
assumptions.impact: Personas and scenario cards are hypotheses; participation and impact claims are not validated.

assumptions.statement: Mentioned schools, research institutions, enterprises, cultural institutions, government bodies, and standards organizations are references, not confirmed partners.
assumptions.impact: Governance roles in the proposal are proposed responsibilities, never commitments or endorsements.

assumptions.statement: Budgets, operators, procurement routes, staffing, data controllers, and annual event calendars are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Each phase is gated by owner, funding, legal, safety, accessibility, and maintenance confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Content provenance can show origin and edit history but cannot prove that a claim is true.
assumptions.impact: Public release still requires source checks, human review, appeal, correction, and withdrawal paths.
